prompt_authorship: The five subject descriptions and shared prompt template were generated with AI assistance and manually reviewed and approved by the student.
prompt_template: Studio image of {subject_description}. Isolated, centered, fully visible, three-quarter view, plain gray background, diffuse lighting, realistic material. No people, props, text, logo, watermark, cropping, or duplicates.
prompt_template_rationale: The shared template keeps composition, viewpoint, background, and lighting consistent across cases while isolating a single complete object with strong boundaries for the downstream single-image TRELLIS.2 reconstruction. Subject descriptions vary the intended geometric or material challenge without changing the imaging conditions.
subject_description: a vintage mint-green metal desk fan with five blades, a circular wire cage, and a compact rounded base
expanded_prompt: Studio image of a vintage mint-green metal desk fan with five blades, a circular wire cage, and a compact rounded base. Isolated, centered, fully visible, three-quarter view, plain gray background, diffuse lighting, realistic material. No people, props, text, logo, watermark, cropping, or duplicates.
challenge: thin cage wires and repeated radial structures
selection_rationale: Test whether the text-to-image and image-to-3D stages can preserve thin, disconnected-looking structures and an explicitly requested repeated-part count.
analysis_focus: Whether FLUX preserves a single coherent wire cage and the correct blade count before 3D reconstruction.
